notes.title: Now Available
notes.notes:
The fantasy open world MMO "Youxing Continent" is now available today! Seamless exploration of the world map, free build genre matching, large-scale city battles, PVE and PVP, challenge the limits of the big secret group, etc.... There are many ways to play waiting for you to experience! Whether you are a single player or a social expert, you can find exclusive game fun in this fantasy continent!

notes.title: Officially launched on April 2
notes.notes:
The open world MMO game "Youxing Continent" is officially scheduled to be launched on April 2rd（PDT）. Let's experience the pure fun of MMO together!

[u][b]The English translation of this official release has not been completed yet and it will take some time. We will update it as soon as it is completed. Please be patient. Thank you.[/b][/u]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45341092/98071d7b6944418927271ae87d98dbaf3c15ad26.jpg[/img]

More than 100 million genre combinations
Want freedom? Interesting? More strategic? Satisfy all your wishes at once!
In Youxing Continent, you can freely choose BD equipment, skills, runes, etc. to match your own genre combination!

Seasonal gameplay, no progress, return at any time
New season, new friends, new pursuits! Break through the shackles of traditional MMO! Return at any time and experience at any time!
In the process of growth, players can participate in a lot of special content, such as: city battles, multi-city battles, team leagues and other rich team gameplay.

Freely explore the fantasy world
In the fresh and magnificent fantasy MMO open world, you can seamlessly explore any accessible corner, or concentrate on collecting and harvesting the rich materials in the world, or wander around and appreciate this beautiful and vibrant Youxing Continent.

notes.title: The demo will be shut down today and the official version will be launched soon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
       The demo experience of the new product festival of "Youxing Continent" will be officially ended at 10 am today and the files will be deleted and the server will be shut down. This trial will also be completed. At the same time, we will announce a new news for everyone. The official version will be launched in April, so stay tuned!

       In addition, we are preparing for the English translation, but in the end we can only complete some core translations, but we will continue to optimize.

notes.title: Demo trial officially starts today
notes.notes:
Open World, the pure MMO game "Youxing Continent" officially started demo testing at 10am today. You can install and try it for free on Steam and Steam platform game stores. At the same time, the Spring Festival promotion will be launched simultaneously on Steam and Steam platforms. It is said that many game masterpieces will participate in discount promotions! In addition, this trial test will last for a relatively long time. Please follow our Q group or official website for the latest news on the specific end time.
